description: Pôle Vie Quotidienne - Stationnements vélos gares du Réseau Ferré National de la Communauté de communes Autour de Chenonceaux Bléré-Val de Cher is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data de la CC Autour de Chenonceaux Bléré-Val de Cher, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Centre-Val de Loire. Recensement et caractérisation des stationnements cyclables disponibles dans et autour des gares ferroviaires de la Communauté de communes Autour de Chenonceaux Bléré-Val de Cher. Coverage: Autour de Chenonceaux (Indre-et-Loire). The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are vélo, gare, stationnement. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-cc-autourdechenonceaux-fr-portal.
